newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks weak, Multisource up 28 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks weak, Multisource up 28 pct.

text.p: 0829 GMT - South AFrican shares open weaker in quiet trade, with industrials easing as players reluctant to take positions ahead of the weekend. Golds also soft amid a lack of interest despite a firmer bullion price.
* Dealers say volumes very light, boosted by a bookover in Iscor and Sappi. Trade seen quiet and volumes thin during the day. Iscor up a cent to 302 cents, Sappi up 50 cents to 42 rand.

* Multisource Holdings Ltd surged to a new year high after an announcement that the company was on the verge of a restructuring, dealers said. It was the highest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) despite announcing poor year results earlier on Friday.
Multisource was last at 450 cents, 100 cents higher.
* All-shares down 13.9 points to 7,060.8, industrials fall 20.6 points to 8,297.3 and golds lose 6.9 points to near four year lows at 1,174.7.
